in_marathi.name: Noopur
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Jewel, Precious one
in_marathi.long_meaning: Noopur हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Noopur is derived from the Sanskrit language, where ‘Noo’ means 'new' and ‘Pur’ means 'jewel' or 'precious one'. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the goddess Parvati, a form of Shiva's consort, was given the name Noopur, as she was the newest form of creation and precious to her husband Shiva.
